    Team tactics

    Field, scoring and restarts

    Throw from green quadrants. Run or hand off in the yellow runway. Every role can use the entire blue center zone. Only Anchors can enter the opposite half. The dirt strips are open to off-ball players but out of bounds for the ball. A carried, thrown, tipped or loose ball entering dirt is dead, and the opponent takes a quadrant reset. More than three uninterrupted seconds unblocked in the ring gives the opponent a free run lane.

    Carry through the ring for 2, or catch a teammate’s pass in blue and finish for 3. A center interception or fumble recovery earns 1 and possession. Catch a legal airborne save kick in blue for 5. A tie goes to runway-only sudden death. The next score wins.

    A quadrant tackle gives the carrier a stationary throw. A runway tackle turns it over. A center catch stopped short retains possession. Incompletions stay live unless the ball enters an out-of-bounds dirt strip.

    Match field

    Field guide

    Both teams attack the 4-yard ring inside the 10-yard center zone. A tackle short of the ring stops the finish. Watch for Anchors blocking off the ball, slipping toward the ring or drawing a defender away from a cut. Carry in for two or catch in the blue and finish for three. Watch the gold ball and its shadow to read the height of a pass or bounce. Gold outlines show blocks and pile drives. A center catch directly from an airborne kick save earns five. New match draws two fresh squads.
